size.name: Size (%)
size.help: Controls the overall size (value shown is the size of the head)

type.name: Type
type.help: Allows you to choose one of the variants of this design

armWidth.name: Arm width (%)
armWidth.help: Controls the width of the arms

armLength.name: Arm length (%)
armLength.help: Controls the length of the arms

neckWidth.name: Neck width (%)
neckWidth.help: Determines the width at the neck

armTaper.name: Arm tapering (%)
armTaper.help: Controls the amount by which the arms taper

bottomTopArmRatio.name: Bottom/Top arm ratio (%)
bottomTopArmRatio.help: Changes the ratio between the fabric on the top of the arms versus that on the bottom of the arms

bottomArmReductionPlushy.name: Bottom arm reduction (plushy) (%)
bottomArmReductionPlushy.help: This changes how long the bottom fabric of the arms is compared to the top fabric. It makes the arms more curly

bottomArmReduction.name: Bottom arm reduction (%)
bottomArmReduction.help: This changes how long the bottom fabric of the arms is compared to the top fabric. It makes the arms more curly
